30: func NewHTTPTransactionChainReader(baseURL string) *HTTPTransactionChainReader {
31: 	return &HTTPTransactionChainReader{
32: 		baseURL: strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"),
33: 		client:  &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Second},

37: func (r *HTTPTransactionChainReader) GetChainSnapshot(ctx context.Context) (*ChainSnapshot, error) {
38: 	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, r.baseURL+"/chain", nil)
39: 	if err != nil {
40: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create chain snapshot request: %w", err)
41: 	}
42: 
43: 	resp, err := r.client.Do(req)
44: 	if err != nil {
45: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch chain snapshot: %w", err)
46: 	}
47: 	defer resp.Body.Close()
48: 
49: 	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
50: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("chain snapshot request failed with status %d", resp.StatusCode)
51: 	}
52: 
53: 	var snapshot ChainSnapshot
54: 	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&snapshot); err != nil {
55: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode chain snapshot: %w", err)
56: 	}
57: 	return &snapshot, nil
58: }

60: type Service struct {
61: 	reader        ChainReader
62: 	oracleClient  OracleSettlementClient
63: 	mu            sync.RWMutex
64: 	lastProcessed uint64
65: 	batches       map[string]*RollupBatch
66: 	persistPath   string
67: }

69: func NewService(reader ChainReader, oracleClient OracleSettlementClient) *Service {
70: 	return &Service{
71: 		reader:       reader,
72: 		oracleClient: oracleClient,
73: 		batches:      make(map[string]*RollupBatch),
74: 	}
75: }

77: type persistedState struct {
78: 	LastProcessed uint64         `json:"last_processed"`
79: 	Batches       []*RollupBatch `json:"batches"`
80: }

82: func (s *Service) SetPersistencePath(path string) error {
83: 	if path == "" {
84: 		return nil
85: 	}
86: 
87: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0755); err != nil {
88: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create rollup persistence directory: %w", err)
89: 	}
90: 
91: 	s.mu.Lock()
92: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
93: 
94: 	s.persistPath = path
95: 	return s.loadStateLocked()
96: }

98: func (s *Service) BuildNextBatch(ctx context.Context) (*RollupBatch, error) {
99: 	snapshot, err := s.reader.GetChainSnapshot(ctx)
100: 	if err != nil {
101: 		return nil, err
102: 	}
103: 
104: 	s.mu.RLock()
105: 	lastProcessed := s.lastProcessed
106: 	s.mu.RUnlock()
107: 
108: 	var candidateBlocks []BlockRecord
109: 	for _, block := range snapshot.Blocks {
110: 		if block.BlockNumber > lastProcessed {
111: 			candidateBlocks = append(candidateBlocks, block)
112: 		}
113: 	}
114: 
115: 	if len(candidateBlocks) == 0 {
116: 		return nil, nil
117: 	}
118: 
119: 	sort.Slice(candidateBlocks, func(i, j int) bool {
120: 		return candidateBlocks[i].BlockNumber < candidateBlocks[j].BlockNumber
121: 	})
122: 
123: 	batch := &RollupBatch{
124: 		ID:          "rollup-" + uuid.NewString(),
125: 		ChainID:     snapshot.ChainID,
126: 		StartHeight: candidateBlocks[0].BlockNumber,
127: 		EndHeight:   candidateBlocks[len(candidateBlocks)-1].BlockNumber,
128: 		Blocks:      candidateBlocks,
129: 		Status:      StatusBuilt,
130: 		CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
131: 		UpdatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
132: 	}
133: 	batch.BatchRoot = computeBatchRoot(candidateBlocks)
134: 
135: 	s.mu.Lock()
136: 	s.batches[batch.ID] = batch
137: 	if err := s.persistStateLocked(); err != nil {
138: 		delete(s.batches, batch.ID)
139: 		s.mu.Unlock()
140: 		return nil, err
141: 	}
142: 	s.mu.Unlock()
143: 
144: 	return batch, nil
145: }

147: func (s *Service) SubmitBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) (*RollupBatch, error) {
148: 	s.mu.RLock()
149: 	batch, ok := s.batches[batchID]
150: 	s.mu.RUnlock()
151: 	if !ok {
152: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rollup batch not found: %s", batchID)
153: 	}
154: 
155: 	settlementID, err := s.oracleClient.SubmitRollup(batch)
156: 	if err != nil {
157: 		s.mu.Lock()
158: 		batch.Status = StatusFailed
159: 		batch.Error = err.Error()
160: 		batch.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
161: 		s.mu.Unlock()
162: 		return nil, err
163: 	}
164: 
165: 	txCount := 0
166: 	for _, block := range batch.Blocks {
167: 		txCount += len(block.Transactions)
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	s.mu.Lock()
171: 	batch.Status = StatusSubmitted
172: 	batch.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
173: 	batch.Settlement = SettlementMetadata{
174: 		BatchID:      batch.ID,
175: 		BatchRoot:    batch.BatchRoot,
176: 		ChainID:      batch.ChainID,
177: 		StartHeight:  batch.StartHeight,
178: 		EndHeight:    batch.EndHeight,
179: 		BlockCount:   len(batch.Blocks),
180: 		TxCount:      txCount,
181: 		SubmittedAt:  time.Now().UTC(),
182: 		SettlementID: settlementID,
183: 	}
184: 	s.lastProcessed = batch.EndHeight
185: 	if err := s.persistStateLocked(); err != nil {
186: 		s.mu.Unlock()
187: 		return nil, err
188: 	}
189: 	s.mu.Unlock()
190: 
191: 	return batch, nil
192: }

194: func (s *Service) MarkSettled(batchID string, settledAt time.Time) (*RollupBatch, error) {
195: 	s.mu.Lock()
196: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
197: 
198: 	batch, ok := s.batches[batchID]
199: 	if !ok {
200: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rollup batch not found: %s", batchID)
201: 	}
202: 
203: 	batch.Status = StatusSettled
204: 	batch.UpdatedAt = settledAt.UTC()
205: 	batch.Settlement.SettledAt = settledAt.UTC()
206: 	if err := s.persistStateLocked(); err != nil {
207: 		return nil, err
208: 	}
209: 	return batch, nil
210: }
211: 
212: func (s *Service) MarkDisputed(batchID string, reason string) (*RollupBatch, error) {
213: 	s.mu.Lock()
214: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
215: 
216: 	batch, ok := s.batches[batchID]
217: 	if !ok {
218: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rollup batch not found: %s", batchID)
219: 	}
220: 
221: 	batch.Status = StatusDisputed
222: 	batch.Error = reason
223: 	batch.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
224: 	if err := s.persistStateLocked(); err != nil {
225: 		return nil, err
226: 	}
227: 	return batch, nil
228: }

230: func (s *Service) GetBatch(batchID string) (*RollupBatch, bool) {
231: 	s.mu.RLock()
232: 	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
233: 	batch, ok := s.batches[batchID]
234: 	return batch, ok
235: }
236: 
237: func (s *Service) ListBatches(limit int) []*RollupBatch {
238: 	s.mu.RLock()
239: 	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
240: 
241: 	batches := make([]*RollupBatch, 0, len(s.batches))
242: 	for _, batch := range s.batches {
243: 		copyBatch := *batch
244: 		copyBatch.Blocks = append([]BlockRecord(nil), batch.Blocks...)
245: 		batches = append(batches, &copyBatch)
246: 	}
247: 
248: 	sort.Slice(batches, func(i, j int) bool {
249: 		return batches[i].CreatedAt.After(batches[j].CreatedAt)
250: 	})
251: 
252: 	if limit > 0 && len(batches) > limit {
253: 		batches = batches[:limit]
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return batches
257: }
258: 
259: func (s *Service) GetStatus() ServiceStatus {
260: 	s.mu.RLock()
261: 	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
262: 
263: 	status := ServiceStatus{
264: 		LastProcessed:   s.lastProcessed,
265: 		BatchCount:      len(s.batches),
266: 		BatchesByStatus: make(map[BatchStatus]int),
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	var latest *RollupBatch
270: 	for _, batch := range s.batches {
271: 		status.BatchesByStatus[batch.Status]++
272: 		if latest == nil || batch.UpdatedAt.After(latest.UpdatedAt) {
273: 			latest = batch
274: 		}
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	if latest != nil {
278: 		status.LatestBatchID = latest.ID
279: 		status.LatestBatchStatus = latest.Status
280: 		status.LatestUpdatedAt = latest.UpdatedAt
281: 	}
282: 
283: 	return status
284: }
285: 
286: func (s *Service) ReconcileWithOracle(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
287: 	s.mu.RLock()
288: 	candidateIDs := make([]string, 0, len(s.batches))
289: 	for id, batch := range s.batches {
290: 		if batch.Status == StatusSubmitted {
291: 			candidateIDs = append(candidateIDs, id)
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	s.mu.RUnlock()
295: 
296: 	updated := 0
297: 	for _, batchID := range candidateIDs {
298: 		select {
299: 		case <-ctx.Done():
300: 			return updated, ctx.Err()
301: 		default:
302: 		}
303: 
304: 		record, err := s.oracleClient.GetRollup(batchID)
305: 		if err != nil {
306: 			return updated, fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch oracle rollup %s: %w", batchID, err)
307: 		}
308: 
309: 		status, _ := record["status"].(string)
310: 		switch strings.ToLower(status) {
311: 		case "finalized":
312: 			settledAt := extractTimestamp(record["finalized_at"], time.Now().UTC())
313: 			if _, err := s.MarkSettled(batchID, settledAt); err != nil {
314: 				return updated, fmt.Errorf("failed to mark batch %s settled: %w", batchID, err)
315: 			}
316: 			updated++
317: 		case "disputed":
318: 			reason, _ := record["dispute"].(string)
319: 			if reason == "" {
320: 				reason = "oracle marked batch as disputed"
321: 			}
322: 			if _, err := s.MarkDisputed(batchID, reason); err != nil {
323: 				return updated, fmt.Errorf("failed to mark batch %s disputed: %w", batchID, err)
324: 			}
325: 			updated++
326: 		}
327: 	}
328: 
329: 	return updated, nil
330: }
331: 
332: func computeBatchRoot(blocks []BlockRecord) string {
333: 	payload, _ := json.Marshal(blocks)
334: 	sum := sha256.Sum256(payload)
335: 	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
336: }
337: 
338: func (s *Service) loadStateLocked() error {
339: 	if s.persistPath == "" {
340: 		return nil
341: 	}
342: 
343: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(s.persistPath)
344: 	if err != nil {
345: 		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
346: 			return nil
347: 		}
348: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read rollup state: %w", err)
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	var state persistedState
352: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
353: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to decode rollup state: %w", err)
354: 	}
355: 
356: 	s.lastProcessed = state.LastProcessed
357: 	s.batches = make(map[string]*RollupBatch, len(state.Batches))
358: 	for _, batch := range state.Batches {
359: 		if batch == nil {
360: 			continue
361: 		}
362: 		s.batches[batch.ID] = batch
363: 	}
364: 
365: 	return nil
366: }
367: 
368: func (s *Service) persistStateLocked() error {
369: 	if s.persistPath == "" {
370: 		return nil
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	batches := make([]*RollupBatch, 0, len(s.batches))
374: 	for _, batch := range s.batches {
375: 		batches = append(batches, batch)
376: 	}
377: 
378: 	sort.Slice(batches, func(i, j int) bool {
379: 		return batches[i].CreatedAt.Before(batches[j].CreatedAt)
380: 	})
381: 
382: 	payload, err := json.MarshalIndent(persistedState{
383: 		LastProcessed: s.lastProcessed,
384: 		Batches:       batches,
385: 	}, "", "  ")
386: 	if err != nil {
387: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to encode rollup state: %w", err)
388: 	}
389: 
390: 	tempPath := s.persistPath + ".tmp"
391: 	if err := os.WriteFile(tempPath, payload, 0644); err != nil {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write rollup state temp file: %w", err)
393: 	}
394: 
395: 	if err := os.Rename(tempPath, s.persistPath); err != nil {
396: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to move rollup state into place: %w", err)
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	return nil
400: }
401: 
402: func extractTimestamp(value interface{}, fallback time.Time) time.Time {
403: 	switch v := value.(type) {
404: 	case string:
405: 		if parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v); err == nil {
406: 			return parsed.UTC()
407: 		}
408: 	case float64:
409: 		return time.Unix(int64(v), 0).UTC()
410: 	case json.Number:
411: 		if seconds, err := strconv.ParseInt(v.String(), 10, 64); err == nil {
412: 			return time.Unix(seconds, 0).UTC()
413: 		}
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	return fallback.UTC()
417: }

## Pipeline Flow

```
Transaction Chain (Node.js miner, port 9190)
  ↓ GET /chain  (ChainSnapshot: blocks + transactions)
Rollup Service (every 30s tick)
  └─ BuildNextBatch() → collects unprocessed blocks, SHA-256 batch root
  └─ SubmitBatch() → calls oracleRollupAdapter.SubmitRollup()
       └─ Oracle Manager → knirvoracle binary
  └─ ReconcileWithOracle() → polls oracle for finalized/disputed statuses
       └─ MarkSettled() or MarkDisputed()
  ↓
HTTP API: GET /api/rollups/status|/{id}|
  ↓
Persistence: JSON file at <appdata>/rollups/transaction_rollups.json
```

**State machine**: `pending → built → submitted → settled | disputed | failed`
